name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited
summary: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited provides renewable engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services in India, Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, rest of Africa, the United States, Latin America, and Australia. It operates through two segments, EPC Business; and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Service.
